headword: {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}
gloss: day trip; excursion without an overnight stay

definitions.explanation: A trip to a destination and back within the same day, without staying overnight. Common for sightseeing, hot springs, hiking, and other leisure activities.

examples.japanese: {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}で{箱根|はこね}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to Hakone on a day trip.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{気軽|きがる}に{楽|たの}しめる{日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}を{計画|けいかく}した。
examples.english: I planned an easy day trip to enjoy on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {新幹線|しんかんせん}を{使|つか}えば、{京都|きょうと}への{日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}も{十分|じゅうぶん}{可能|かのう}です。
examples.english: If you use the bullet train, a day trip to Kyoto is entirely possible.

examples.japanese: {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}なら{荷物|にもつ}も{少|すく}なくて{済|す}む。
examples.english: If it's a day trip, you can get by with less luggage.

notes:
Composed of {日帰|ひがえ}り (returning the same day) and {旅行|りょこう} (travel, trip). Japan's extensive rail network, especially the {新幹線|しんかんせん}, makes day trips practical even to destinations several hundred kilometers away.

Travel agencies and websites frequently advertise {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう} packages that bundle transportation, meals, and activities for a single-day outing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}プラン: day trip plan/package
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}ツアー: day trip tour
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん}{旅行|りょこう}: day trip to hot springs
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}に{出|で}かける: to go on a day trip

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日帰|ひがえ}り: same-day return — the core word, used without {旅行|りょこう} when the context is clear
- {遠足|えんそく}: excursion, field trip — typically a school or group outing, often on foot
- {小旅行|しょうりょこう}: short trip — may include an overnight stay, unlike {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}
